caption:
ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity all write, research, and summarize now. A year ago they had different strengths. In 2026 the overlap is real — and so is the chance you're paying full price for the same job three times.

This isn't an argument to cancel everything. Some overlap is a legitimate backup plan. But most solo operators have never actually mapped which subscription does which task.

Copy-paste this into whichever AI tool you trust most:

"Here are my AI subscriptions and what I pay for each: [list them with monthly cost]. Here's what I actually use them for in a normal week: [list tasks]. Tell me which subscriptions overlap on the same task, and which one I could drop without losing a capability I use weekly."

Fill in your real numbers and let it do the arithmetic.

Save this before your next batch of renewals hits.
